anomalies.observed: The netlist places screw terminal J5 directly on the MCU heater-control net: J5 pin 2 is on /Microcontroller/HEATER (also ESP32 GPIO1 and TPS1H200 IN/DIAG_EN), and J5 pin 1 is on GND.
anomalies.expected: The specification describes only J6 as the heater connector driven by U6 OUT; it does not include an external screw terminal on the GPIO1/U6 control net. A connector on this net should not be present unless intended as a documented manual override/input with proper protection.

evidence.quote: OUT (pin 7) feeds the heater connector J6 pin 2

anomalies.impact: Closing or wiring J5 can short the heater-control line to ground, overriding firmware heater control and potentially causing ESP32 GPIO1 output contention; an external voltage applied to J5 could also reach GPIO1 and U6 IN/DIAG_EN without protection.

parsed.summary: Most connectivity and values match the specification, but screw terminal J5 is connected between GND and the MCU/U6 heater-control net, which is not described in the intended design and could override or damage the heater control path if used.
